_comment: Coverage map for check-features (docs/testing/feature-coverage.md). Maps each documented requirement unit (FR-N.M / NFR-N.M, or a N.M subsection number for older docs) to the test(s) that would fail if the behavior regressed. Stateful units set stateful:true and list the transitions the tests exercise. This map is intentionally partial; `npm run check:features` reports every unmapped or under-tested unit as a gap. Filling it out is an ongoing exercise (see the doc).

FR-27.1.note: ensureGlassboxGitignored runs at launch inside a git repo.

transitions: no trailing newline -> block appended cleanly
FR-27.3.note: Idempotency is a transition, not a single-op check: run twice, second run must not change the file.

transitions: stale bare '.glassbox/' -> replaced with canonical block
multiple stale lines -> collapsed into one block at first position
commented opt-out present -> file left untouched
any commented .glassbox variant -> treated as opt-out

NFR-27.1.note: computeGitignore is a pure function; the whole suite exercises it without touching disk.

NFR-27.2.note: Unrelated entries containing the word glassbox are left untouched.

FR-26.4.note: loadGroundTruthManifest resolves actual<->expected pairs relative to the manifest dir.

FR-26.5.note: comparePerceptual difference score; PNG/JPEG decode, SVG/corrupt -> undecodable.
